description: Two layers of authorization for apps behind Apps Gateway.

gatewayLayer.name: Who may enter the app
gatewayLayer.managedBy: DevOps or an authorized app owner in the console. NEVER changed by an agent or by these plugins — the access mode decides who may enter the application. Report the intended value and who must apply it; never apply it yourself (see apps-gateway.json registration.performedBy).

appLayer.name: Finer roles/permissions inside the app
notes: Gateway admin flag from /auth/api/me is for gateway account/app-management — do not repurpose as app role
Maintain user → roles in the app database
